mcq.question: Why must HTTP Basic auth only be used over TLS?

options.A: Base64 is an encoding, so anyone who sees the header can decode the password
options.B: Base64 is too slow without TLS
options.C: Servers reject Basic auth over plain HTTP
options.D: Base64 needs a TLS key to decode

mcq.explanation: Base64 hides nothing. The credentials are protected only by the encrypted connection.

mcq.question: Why does the token cache refresh 30 seconds *before* expiry?

options.B: It halves the number of token fetches
options.C: So a token cannot expire while a request carrying it is still in flight

mcq.explanation: A token that expires during the request gives a 401. A safety margin avoids that race.
